answer: Rule: no identity trades alone. Every identity locks 40 units into a mutual trellis bond with one distinct partner, slashed from both sides if either is proven a duplicate. A lone fake is an island: it cannot pair with itself, so each fake needs a real partner risking 40 units too, costing 80 units locked per fake, scaling linearly. One pairing slot per partner per epoch caps fakes at the partner pool. A pearl of trust is earned only after one full epoch paired without challenge.
